diagnostics.message: The probe deletion action should wait until HTTP settings that may reference the probe have been deleted; otherwise Azure may reject or retain the referenced probe.
The frontend port deletion action should wait until HTTP listeners that use the port have been deleted.
The explicit dependency on set_backend_pools is already implied transitively through set_http_settings, which depends on set_backend_pools.
The explicit dependency on set_root_cert is already implied transitively through set_http_settings, which depends on set_root_cert.
set_probe already depends on set_backend_pools, so this explicit dependency duplicates an existing transitive ordering.
set_url_path_rule already depends on set_http_settings, so this explicit dependency duplicates an existing transitive ordering.
set_url_path_rule already depends transitively on set_backend_pools; the direct dependency is redundant.
set_url_path_rule already depends on set_http_listener, so this direct dependency duplicates an existing transitive ordering.
set_url_path_rule already depends transitively on set_ssl_cert; the direct dependency is redundant.
set_url_path_rule already depends transitively on set_root_cert; the direct dependency is redundant.
set_url_path_rule already depends on set_url_path_map, so this direct dependency duplicates an existing transitive ordering.
The explicit dependency on delete_backend_pool is already implied transitively through delete_http_settings, which depends on delete_backend_pool.
The explicit dependency on delete_root_cert is already implied transitively through delete_http_settings, which depends on delete_root_cert.
The explicit dependency on delete_ssl_cert is already implied transitively through delete_http_settings, which depends on delete_ssl_cert.
The explicit dependency on delete_backend_pool is transitively implied because delete_http_settings depends on delete_ssl_cert and delete_root_cert, which themselves depend on delete_backend_pool.
delete_ssl_cert already depends on delete_backend_pool, so this direct dependency is transitively redundant.
The explicit dependency on delete_backend_pool is already implied through delete_http_settings, which depends on delete_backend_pool.
The explicit dependency on delete_root_cert is already implied through delete_http_settings, which depends on delete_root_cert.
The explicit dependency on delete_ssl_cert is already implied through delete_http_settings, which depends on delete_ssl_cert.

delete_url_path_map already depends on delete_http_settings, delete_backend_pool, delete_http_listener, delete_root_cert, and delete_ssl_cert; therefore these direct dependencies on those same targets are transitive duplicates.
delete_url_path_map already depends on delete_http_listener, so this direct dependency is transitively redundant.
delete_url_path_map already depends on delete_http_settings, so this direct dependency is transitively redundant.
delete_url_path_map already depends on delete_root_cert, so this direct dependency is transitively redundant.
delete_url_path_map already depends on delete_ssl_cert, so this direct dependency is transitively redundant.
set_http_settings already depends on set_backend_pools through set_probe.
set_http_settings already depends on set_root_cert, so this direct dependency is transitively redundant.
set_url_path_map already depends on set_backend_pools, making this explicit dependency transitively redundant.
set_url_path_map already depends on set_http_settings, so this direct dependency is transitively redundant.
set_url_path_map already depends on set_http_listener, so this direct dependency is transitively redundant.
set_url_path_map already depends on set_ssl_cert, so this direct dependency is transitively redundant.
set_url_path_map already depends on set_root_cert, so this direct dependency is transitively redundant.

HTTP settings can reference probes, so the HTTP-settings delete action should run before the probe delete action. Make the HTTP-settings deletion node depend on the probe deletion node so Terraform destroys the settings first.

HTTP listeners use frontend ports, so the listener delete action should run before the frontend-port delete action. Make the listener deletion node depend on the frontend-port deletion node so Terraform destroys the listener first.
delete_root_cert already depends on delete_ssl_cert, which itself depends on delete_backend_pool; the direct delete_backend_pool dependency is redundant.
delete_http_settings already depends on delete_root_cert, which depends on delete_ssl_cert, so its direct dependency on delete_ssl_cert is transitively redundant.
delete_request_routing_rule already depends on delete_url_path_rule, which depends on delete_url_path_map, and the map depends on delete_backend_pool.
delete_request_routing_rule already depends on delete_url_path_rule, which depends on delete_url_path_map, and the map depends on delete_http_listener.
delete_request_routing_rule already depends on delete_url_path_rule, which depends on delete_url_path_map, and the map depends on delete_http_settings.
delete_request_routing_rule already depends on delete_url_path_rule, which depends on delete_url_path_map, and the map depends on delete_root_cert.
delete_request_routing_rule already depends on delete_url_path_rule, which depends on delete_url_path_map, and the map depends on delete_ssl_cert.
delete_request_routing_rule already depends on delete_url_path_rule, which depends on delete_url_path_map.
